pageProps.title: Gossine
pageProps.review: A frank review of the unique Korean fusion menu, including Samgye Sujebi and Perilla Leaf Sherbet, tasted and recorded at Gossine on Sinpung-ro, Paldal-gu, Suwon.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Samgye Sujebi", "rating": 3.5 } --- It's Sujebi, but it really tastes like Samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup). ``` ```menu { "title": "Oyster and Seaweed Fulvescens Pasta", "rating": 3.5 } --- It's a decent pasta taste, but there were too many herbs, which was somewhat distracting. ``` ```menu { "title": "Gossi Sand", "rating": 3 } --- It was hard to eat, but the taste wasn't bad. I'm not sure if the cod meat and salted seafood taste on top of the toast go well together. ``` ```menu { "title": "Perilla Leaf Sherbet", "rating": 4 } --- Surprisingly delicious. It was the best thing I had. The taste changes significantly when a bit of Mungyeong Baram (apple brandy) is added. Even more delicious. ``` ## Review There were many very unique menus. Especially ```Samgye Sujebi``` was a combination I had for the first time. ## Pictures
